records.readable_german: Dtsche Militaermission in Konstantinopel. Zu Nr 45610. Komdo des Oberlts Siegfried nach der Tuerkei, dessen Zuteilung zur Militaermission ist aufgehoben. AKO folgt. Auf allerhoechsten Befehl Chef Militaerkabinetts Frhr Marschall.
records.meaning: Regarding 45610 and the posting of Oberleutnant Siegfried to Turkey, the message cancels his assignment to the Military Mission. AKO follows. It closes with the Chief of the Military Cabinet formula and FRHR MARSCHALL. The message does not report a completed return journey or establish a separate biographical identity.

already_reviewed_closing_witness.interpretation: The direct58-character closing independently supports the damaged Military Cabinet formula and FRHR MARSCHALL in p135 A. The older message concerns Osthoff; this is formula-level support, not an identical full message or a biographical identity claim.

limits: All401 source slots, including397 observed coordinates and4 printed masks, are retained literally. The ordinary odd-frame decoding and its final orphan are retained separately.

The recovery is conditional on an observed surplus X in the fractionated stream before transposition. Excluding interim230 or231 yields the same400-coordinate paired stream; neither physical origin is uniquely chosen. This is not a silent deletion from transmitted ciphertext.
Under this declared model the candidate costs7 observed substitutions and4 printed-mask fills. The extra observed X is separately accounted for, not treated as a free erasure.
All401 interim and401 transmitted single-coordinate exclusions are priced against the same200-character proposal. This does not exclude other multi-error mechanisms or establish a historical cause.
The complete closing has direct pair-by-pair support from already-reviewed p149 A2, without importing its Osthoff identity or other body words.
The source reference45610 remains literal. The unchanged published key retains its prior attribution and no first-solution priority is claimed.
